mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mcp_prompt_version (prompt_name, version, template, status, note, operator, label, update_time) VALUES (#{promptName}, #{version}, #{template}, #{status}, #{note}, #{operator}, #{label}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
